title: German Flank Steak Kebabs
description: Grilled flank steak kebabs with a German twist, marinated in a mix of exotic spices and served with a side of sautéed onions.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, spice blend, salt, and pepper.
Add the flank steak to the marinade and coat evenly.
Let the steak marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated steak, onions, bell peppers, and zucchini onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the steak reaches an internal temperature of 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Sauté the sliced onions in a pan with a little bit of oil until caramelized and golden brown.
